Navigate to the next priority plan in the sequence.



The sequence includes all active and in_progress priority plans, sorted by:

1. in_progress plans first

2. Then active plans by active_order (lower first)

3. Then by plan_date (descending)

  View backlog items for next plan
  zqk pplan next
  View in JSON format
  zqk pplan next --format json

Usage:
  zqk object pplan next [flags]

Flags:
      --filter stringArray   Filter by field (format: field=value or field:value, can be used multiple times)
      --sort-asc             Sort ascending (default: true) (default true)
      --sort-by string       Field to sort by

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
